description: Eyes-on-pixels validation: a fresh judge LOOKS AT each recorded settled still and decides whether it visibly demonstrates the requirement and is legible {met, readable}. Catches what code review, DOM assertions, and even axe miss (dead controls, poor contrast, wrong-moment frames). Pairs with record-demos + check-recordings; on any miss, fix -> re-record -> re-verify until met.

clips.requirement: HQ shows the current rank (medal, 'Hodnost 2' and the rank name 'Kadet'), the total XP (275 XP), an XP bar towards the next rank visibly about half full with '125 z 250 XP do hodnosti Strážce', and the number of solved tasks ('Vyřešené úlohy: 2'). No negative XP, timer, streak or leaderboard. Czech UI, legible in the light theme.
At the top rank HQ shows the 5th rank 'Legenda', 1 600 XP, a full XP bar and the words 'Nejvyšší hodnost!' with no 'do hodnosti' next-rank target.

A rank-up celebration on HQ names the new rank: 'Nová hodnost!', the rank name 'Kadet' in a large display face, the sentence 'Postoupila jsi na hodnost Kadet. Jen tak dál!', an original hexagon rank medal (no borrowed anime/manga art), and a 'Super!' button to close it; the HQ progress below shows the same rank. Celebratory but legible.

Under reduced motion the rank-up celebration is shown as a static message with the same text ('Nová hodnost!', 'Kadet', 'Postoupila jsi na hodnost Kadet. Jen tak dál!') and the rank medal, fully visible and legible (nothing faded, half-drawn or mid-animation).

On the task screen a correct answer shows 'Výborně!' with a '+10 XP' sticker, and the rank-up celebration naming the new rank 'Kadet' appears with the feedback, above the 'Další úloha' button; no negative XP anywhere.

The mission-complete screen titled 'Mise je splněná!' shows the XP earned in the run ('+35 XP' sticker and 'Získala jsi 35 XP.'), the first-try count ('1 na první pokus'), the number of tasks ('Úloh v misi: 2'), no rank-up, and the actions 'Zpět na HQ' and 'Zopakovat misi'.
The mission-complete screen shows '+30 XP', '1 na první pokus' and the rank-up celebration with the new rank name 'Kadet' ('Nová hodnost!', the medal and the sentence), legible.

After a replay of a completed mission, the screen 'Opakování je hotové!' says 0 XP were earned because a replay earns no XP ('Získané XP: 0. Za opakování se XP nepřipisují…'), shows the first-try count, and offers 'Zpět na HQ' and 'Zopakovat misi'; the wording is kind, not punishing.

steps.result:
I saved all 8 vision verdicts (all met, all readable), but the timestamp is only a date: I couldn't get the current UTC time. I had no shell or clock in this session, so I used today's date, `2026-10-07`, and left out the time rather than make one up. If you need the full time, run `date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ` and paste the result over the date in the first line of the report.

**What I wrote:**
- **`docs/qa/vision-report.md`**: the table (clip | proves | met | readable | notes) and a Failures section. The notes in the table are shortened; the full verdict text is in the manifest.
- **`docs/qa/demo-recordings/slice8-gamification/manifest.json`**: each of the 8 clips now has `"vision": { "met", "readable", "notes" }`, with your notes copied word for word. The other three manifests (`nfr8-task-entry`, `slice6-authoring-missions`, `slice7-practice-flow`) have none of these clips, so I didn't change them.

**Things worth knowing:**
- **No failures**, but the report lists some non-blocking notes:
  - The labels on `slice8-hq-top-rank` are very small (about 11–12px).
  - Some grey text on `slice8-hq-progress` looks close to the minimum contrast limit by eye. The automated accessibility check should decide that.
  - A screenshot can't prove the reduced-motion requirement (NFR-13), because a still image can't show that nothing moves.
- **Two clips claim more requirements than were checked:**
  - `slice8-mission-complete` claims FR-32 and FR-38 in the manifest, but was only judged for FR-32.
  - `slice8-replay` claims FR-33 and FR-32, but was only judged for FR-33.

  If check-recordings matches the vision verdict against every requirement a clip claims, these two may fail. To fix that, either judge FR-38 and FR-32 for those clips, or remove them from the manifest's proof list.

returned.verdict: all clips visibly prove their requirement and are readable
